english.meaning: broad and wide; used before a group to mean the general public
english.note: 廣大市民 means 'the general public' and 廣大聽眾 means 'listeners at large'.

exampleSentences.english: I mean, the health of all Hong Kong citizens…
exampleSentences.traditional: 即係面對咁廣大市民嘅健康啊，全港市民…

exampleSentences.english: And we especially thank our listeners for their continued support.
exampleSentences.traditional: 亦都要更加多謝即係廣大嘅聽眾一直以來嘅支持喇。
